name: block-destructive-commands
description: Best-effort, on parsed commands (echo ignored); verdicts come from the chock_destructive table shared with rtk-dangerous-actions-blocker. Blocks recursive deletes of root, home or abs paths; mv/chmod/chown -R of system dirs; dd to devices, mkfs, wipefs; account lockouts; force, delete and mirror pushes; history rewrites; IaC destroy; cloud and platform deletes; DB drops. Asks: rm -rf off a safe list, bare lease, stash drop, -auto-approve, drain, prunes, API deletes. Pre- push: no non-ff.
